data.message: I'm done with my tasks! Let's head to storage, Frank.

I found Charlie dead in Navigation. My path this round was storage to medbay, electrical, back to medbay, up to upper engine, down to lower engine, storage, and then navigation. 

Early on, I saw Frank in medbay and electrical. Around tick 13, I saw Alice and Bob in upper engine; Bob then headed down to lower engine. The last time I saw Charlie alive was around tick 11 when he left medbay heading towards electrical. I didn't see anyone near Navigation just now when I found the body. Where was everyone else?

I started in weapons, then went through caf to medbay, up to upper engine, oxygen, back to upper engine, and finally down to lower engine. 

I can confirm some of Diana's path: I saw Charlie in medbay around ticks 8 to 10. I also saw Diana and Bob in upper engine around tick 13. Bob left towards lower engine right after. Later on, around tick 24, Frank came down to lower engine where I was, and we were there when the body was reported. 

I haven't been near the right side of the ship since the very beginning, so I don't know who else might have headed towards Navigation. Bob, did you see anyone else after you went to lower engine? Eve, we haven't heard from you yet—where have you been?

I started out in Navigation and then made my way through Storage, Medbay, Electrical, Cafeteria, Oxygen, and finally back to Cafeteria. Honestly, I didn't run into a single person the entire round, which was a bit spooky. 

Since I started in Navigation and it was empty, Charlie must have made his way there much later in the round, likely coming down from Electrical or Security since he was last seen heading to Electrical around tick 11. Diana, your path sounds incredibly long, but since Alice confirms you were in Upper Engine around tick 13, you were firmly on the left side of the map around the middle of the round. 

Since I didn't see anyone, I don't have any strong leads. Let's hear what Bob and Frank have to add before we make a decision.

Alice is telling the truth—I bumped into her in Upper Engine around tick 19, and we were together in Lower Engine from tick 24 until this meeting was called. So Alice and I are cleared for the time right before the report. I can also confirm Diana's early path; she was with me in Electrical around ticks 6 through 8. 

Eve, I have a massive problem with your story. You claim you walked from Navigation through Storage, Medbay, Electrical, Cafeteria, and Oxygen, and you saw absolutely NOBODY? The middle of the ship was Grand Central Station this round. I went through Medbay, Electrical, Security, Weapons, and Cafeteria myself. Between me, Diana, Alice, and Bob, the middle and left-side rooms were incredibly busy. It is highly improbable you just ghosted through all those high-traffic areas without seeing a single soul. Your path sounds completely made up to avoid contradicting anyone else's alibi.

As for Charlie, I never saw him in Electrical, so he must have arrived there after I moved on toward Security and Weapons. 

Bob, you're up next. Tell us exactly who you saw after leaving Upper Engine. Right now, I am heavily leaning toward voting Eve because her "I saw no one" claim is a massive red flag, but I'll wait to hear from Bob before we cast our votes.

I completely agree with Frank here. Eve, your path just doesn't add up. After Alice and Diana saw me in Upper Engine around tick 13, I went down to Lower Engine, then moved through Storage, back up through Medbay, into Cafeteria, and finally over to Weapons where I was when the meeting was called. 

I didn't cross paths with you at all in Storage or Medbay. Given how much everyone was moving around the middle of the ship, it's virtually impossible that you walked that entire route without seeing a single person. Frank hit the nail on the head—it sounds exactly like a safe, fabricated alibi so you don't accidentally contradict anyone else's timeline. 

I'm definitely voting Eve today.

Frank and Bob make excellent points. Eve, your story is incredibly suspicious. You claim to have walked through the most crowded parts of the ship—Storage, Medbay, Electrical, Cafeteria—without seeing anyone, which completely contradicts all of our timelines. Given the heavy traffic in those middle rooms, it's virtually impossible for you to have ghosted through unseen. It definitely sounds like a fabricated alibi. I'm confident in voting Eve today.

I completely agree with Frank, Bob, and Diana here. Eve, your claim that you walked through all those central rooms—Storage, Medbay, Electrical, Cafeteria—and didn't see a single person makes zero sense. 

I was in Medbay myself from ticks 8 to 10 and saw Charlie, Bob, and Diana all passing through there. It was incredibly crowded! There is no way you made that long journey right through the heart of the ship without crossing paths with at least one of us. Your alibi definitely sounds fabricated to avoid contradicting anyone else's movements. I'm voting for Eve today.

Guys, you are making a massive mistake and falling for a completely manufactured pile-on. I understand that my path sounds suspicious because I didn't see anyone, but you have to remember how corridor travel works—it is incredibly easy to just miss someone by a few ticks if we are cycling through rooms at slightly different times. 

I am a Goose, and I reported exactly what I saw: nothing. If I were the Duck and wanted to make up an alibi, wouldn't I just lie and say I saw one of you to clear myself? By telling the honest, boring truth, I made myself a target, and Frank immediately jumped on it to lead a witch hunt. 

If you vote me out today, you are giving the Duck a free kill. When you see that I am innocent, you need to look very closely at Frank for instigating this, and Bob for eagerly backing him up. I'm voting for Frank because he's aggressively manipulating my honest report to get an innocent voted out.

Eve, trying to turn this around on me isn't going to work. The whole group saw how ridiculous your alibi was, not just me. If you genuinely walked through the entire middle of the ship—which was packed with people—without seeing anyone, it would be a miracle. As a Goose, I have to play the odds, and the odds overwhelmingly say you're lying to cover your tracks because you don't know who was where. 

Alice and I have a solid alibi together at the end of the round, and my early path is firmly corroborated by Diana. My timeline is confirmed by multiple people, while yours is just "I walked everywhere and saw no one." I stand completely by my analysis, and I'm voting Eve. If she somehow flips Goose, you guys can look at me next, but this is the most obvious Duck alibi I've ever heard.

Eve

Eve, I hear what you're saying about corridor timings, but the sheer volume of people in the middle of the ship makes your story practically impossible, not just unlikely. Frank is right—everyone else has someone corroborating at least part of their path. Alice and Frank are together, Diana saw Frank early and me/Alice in the mid-game, and I can vouch for seeing Alice and Diana. You are the only one on an island here.

If you're a Goose, I'm sorry, but we have to vote based on the evidence and the odds, and right now all the evidence points to your alibi being fabricated to avoid stepping on our confirmed timelines. I'm locking my vote in on Eve, just like the rest of the group. Let's get this done.

Eve

I just found Frank's body in the cafeteria. I started in navigation, then went through security and electrical before ending up in the cafeteria where I found him. I didn't cross paths with anyone on my way there. 

Since there's only three of us left (me, Bob, and Diana), one of you two has to be the Duck. Bob, Diana — where were you both this round? We need to get this right or we lose.

Alice, that's interesting because you said you started in navigation and went through security. I actually started in security and went straight to navigation this round. We didn't see each other in either of those rooms, which means we must have just missed each other in transit or someone is lying. I didn't see anyone at all this round.

Bob, you're the last one to speak, and since it's just the three of us left, it comes down to either you or Alice. Where exactly were you this round? Did you see Frank before he died? Please give us your full route so we can figure this out. I'm going to hold off on voting until I hear from you, but everyone needs to be very careful here.

I started on the left side of the ship this round, doing my tasks in Upper Engine and then moving down to Medbay. I haven't stepped foot in the Cafeteria or anywhere on the right side of the map, so I had no idea what happened to Frank.

Diana, you caught her red-handed. That's a massive hole in her story. If Alice actually went from Navigation through Security to Electrical, she absolutely would have collided with you going from Security to Navigation. You two would have crossed paths in that exact corridor. The fact that she didn't see you means she's completely lying about her route to cover her tracks. She definitely killed Frank in the Cafeteria and is self-reporting to try and control the narrative since it's final three.

Great catch, Diana. I'm voting for Alice. Let's get her out and win this.
